Double vision; heavy look about eyes; tinnitus,

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Albuminuria, with casts. Scanty. Pink
color. Constant desire to urinate; scanty, brownish
red. Hjematoporphyrinuria.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Congestion of lungs; stertorous
breathing. Sighing dyspnoea.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Ataxic movements, staggering gait;
cold, weak, trembling; legs seem too heavy. Extreme
restlessness; muscular twitchings. Knee-jerks disap-
pear. Stiffness and paralysis of both legs. Anaesthesia
of legs.
